_note: From the core book, Lifestyle (A Place to Rest, p. 164). Effects are paraphrased, not quoted. nuyenPerRun is added to each run's pay.

squatter.label: Squatter
squatter.effect: Disadvantage on most Influence Tests (GM's discretion).

middle.label: Middle
middle.effect: Advantage on most Influence Tests (GM's discretion).

high.label: High
high.effect: Advantage on most Influence and Network Tests (GM's discretion). Temporary items cost no Edge outside of action; a temporary weapon or vehicle costs 1 Edge.
